cohort: 160 consenting pregnant women scheduled for Cesarean section at the University of Nigeria Teaching Hospital (UNTH) Ituku/Ozalla and Enugu State University of Science and Technology Teaching Hospital (ESUT-TH) Parklane, Enugu, excluding those with clinical chorioamnionitis.
finding: The incidence of post-cesarean SSI was 13.7%, and maternal obesity at booking (BMI >= 30) and postoperative anemia (hemoglobin < 11.0 g/dl) were predictors of SSI.
